name: Dual Landmine Lateral Raise
description: The dual landmine lateral raise uses two landmine setups simultaneously, one on each side, raising both arms laterally at the same time. The bilateral version applies the constant-arc loading of the landmine to both sides simultaneously, training medial deltoids with strict form and removing the possibility of compensating with one side. It is typically performed in front-facing configuration with the bars angled outward.

execution.starting_position: Set up two landmine units with bars angled outward from the floor. Stand between them and hold each bar end in the corresponding hand, arms at sides.
execution.setup_instructions: Ensure both landmine setups are at equal heights and their loaded ends are at the same level. Light loading on each bar.
steps: Step 1: Begin with both arms at sides, bar ends at hip level.
Step 2: Raise both arms simultaneously outward and upward to shoulder height.
Step 4: Lower both arms simultaneously under control.
common_mistakes: One bar going higher than the other — control the symmetry
Shrugging to compensate for heavy load — use lighter bars
safety_considerations: Requires access to two landmine units — plan setup before beginning
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Arms at sides to shoulder height on both sides simultaneously.
coaching_cues: Lead with the elbows — slight bend
